description.value:
By spending an Action and 3 kinesis points, you can use your kinetic shape to create a wall of churning elements, flensing debris, or roiling energy that lasts for 1 minute or until your Concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes half your kinetic shape's damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
